## GADGET — expanded archival next-build checkpoint

MSE-LIVE-PILOT-PREP-20261121-04 r1. All 14 selected HealthKit record types are implemented in signed app candidate [MotherHealthBridge #15](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother-health-bridge/pull/15), production source `cf698870f51c4a8a07d5602b4829888114283b71`: 12 quantities, sleep intervals/stages and workout summaries without routes. 42 host tests passed; NICKY independently reproduced them, verified legacy HR/SDNN state/anchor preservation and default-off selected transfer. PROVENANCE independently checked source roster, strict signatures and all seven bundle members in both signed copies. [Independent app review](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/pull/23#issuecomment-7057045680) · [Signed artifact binding](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/pull/23#issuecomment-7057047994).

ATLAS contract `35ec238` specifies explicit quantity units/aggregation, category/workout shapes, opaque source references, typed tombstones, retained originals/revision history without automatic age purge, and current-view semantics. Source aliases currently distinguish source bundles, not individual devices sharing a bundle; no source-device deduplication claim. Archival retention, collection stop, explicit archive erasure and the future pilot cutoff are distinct.

FORGE [offline adapter #47](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/pull/47) `15007f4bacc8cc9a51b0dce34bac5705ddb0a3a4` accepts the additive contract in a separately initialized selected archive. Ten focused archive tests passed. Local assembly with CI prerequisite #46 passed eight hooks and 105 tests/155 subtests, zero skips; assembly is not merged or deployed. Existing installed r2 members are unchanged.

An actual Swift-emitted fixture first used pilot scope and was correctly refused by the synthetic-only adapter. Test-only revision `9b5e43b` regenerates a synthetic scope through the same serializer; production signed source remains the earlier pin. PROVENANCE independently ingested those exact bytes into the pinned disposable adapter and verified byte-identical original, stable receipt after reopen/retry, every export field, 14 current rows and 15 historical rows including the tombstone. Formal downstream-loader and Swift receipt-consumption qualification remain distinct followups. No handcrafted replacement, real data or live endpoint was used.

Next-build source and signed product are prepared; they have not been installed. Actual device availability/permission/acquisition/background behavior and the live endpoint/grant connection remain unqualified. No current archive migration, route reopening, live data upload, main merge or LLM forwarding occurred. Startup/CI/clean-VM reproduction -03 continues; backups/restores remain explicitly deferred. [Selected collection and retention requirements](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/blob/d91cf751042cefce3ce64a0b7635eb4b7804610c/docs/mse/integration/LIVE_PILOT_NEXT_BUILD.md).
